summary.text: Growling beast painting world is a newly added Divine Emperor City painting whose periphery already holds rank three beast foes and deeper beast tides.

claims.text: Ye Fan enters the outer periphery and meets three yellow leopards of about rank three battle strength with strong concealment. He judges the painting’s level rather high and turns back after a short probe, leaving deeper exploration for later with borrowed local strength.

The ten children of human path build camps rapidly in the newly added growling beast painting world. Craftsman Gu lets them raise ten camps and push deeper, with camps sited for defense and supply beside a stream.

Pioneering armies construct camps at set intervals while logistics fill them. The deeper they go, the stronger the beasts become. In the depths, Genesis Lotus’ will suppresses Mao Li Qiu and extracts its dao marks into the painting, which paints them into birds and beasts until a violent beast tide forms. The tide shatters camps, reduces the army to under one tenth, and drives survivors back to the city. Afterward wild beasts scatter through growling beast painting world and exploration becomes harder. Fang Di Chang analyzes that the painting suppresses a great enemy of Heavenly Court in its depths, and that beast-tide battles weaken that enemy while deepening the suppression.

After the ten children of human path explore growling beast painting world and return in failure, a beast tamer profession appears in the painting world, and beast tamer Gu is created to deal with it. Fang Di Chang then expects the painting world to fall into disadvantage over time.
Golden aurora hands appear in the painting world’s sky: the left grabs qi howling painting world and the right grabs growling beast painting world, opposed by Genesis Lotus’ will.
